_metadata.purpose: Central webhook dispatcher (POST /webhook/dispatch) that normalizes inbound requests into Event Schema v1 and routes via webhook_registry
_metadata.description: Central webhook dispatcher that validates registry and routes to worker workflows.
steps: Normalize to Event Schema v1 (hybrid input supported)
Lookup webhook_registry in Postgres by event_type

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM public.webhook_registry WHERE event_type = $1 AND is_active = true
